loader_ref.note: same load_csv_columns; leftover unused so full leftover length is primary

fault_routes_json.note: fault_routes/2 is Harness first-fault routing (CRITIC_BLIND, SKILL_CONTENT_GAP, ...), not time-series defect kinds. Defect families used here come from the injection taxonomy.

minipipe_injection.level_shift: contiguous offset 40 pts * 1.5 std (mild) or 64 pts * 3.0 std (severe)

forecast_injection.gap: lines 91-128: 80 isolated NaN timestamps (not one long hole)

public_robust_z.note: in-service public z = |x-med| / max(1.4826*MAD, 1e-8), flag at OUTLIER_Z_THRESHOLD=4.0 (contracts/observables.py:16). This census reports the task-specified raw |x-med|/MAD at 5 and 8, which is stricter than public z>=4 and closer to injection amplitude 8.

taxonomy_alignment.zero_policy: traffic is occupancy; zeros are reported as zero_structure only. They are not counted as missing/gap.

definitions.gap: consecutive NaN runs; n_runs and max_run (contracts.py:59-72 geometry)
definitions.zero_run: consecutive exact 0.0 on finite samples; not missing
definitions.impulse_k5_k8: |finite-median|/MAD >= 5 or 8; max consecutive run; isolated := run length <= 3
definitions.level_shift: non-overlapping windows of 168 (hourly week); count adjacent |median_{i+1}-median_i| > 3 * global MAD
definitions.basics: length, mean(finite), MAD(finite), MAD(diff of finite)
definitions.richness_criteria: Headline richness is family-aligned. poor = 0 NaN AND weekly-jump <10% AND (no unconfounded impulse). Occupancy-scale series with ubiquitous isolated MAD-8 (median runs>=5) are occupancy-confounded, not injection-like impulse. rich = >=30% series with NaN or unconfounded impulse or weekly jump. Else moderate. Zeros excluded.

gate_ref.text: G1: estimate revision-trigger base rate (conflict / negative / crowding) per lesson before freezing the pool; proposed threshold >=2/lesson (protocol not yet frozen).

course_ref.structure: one unit ~ one cell; producer then beneficiaries; gap guard

s2a_conflict_lesson_ref.approx: S2A_CONFLICT_FIELD_UNAVAILABLE: in-service impulsive_outlier made menu programs net-positive with no series past harm bar

g1_readout.readout: If these 6 leftover cells were opened as a course (one cell per unit, producer + beneficiary), family-aligned leftover defects cannot supply conflict/negative revision material: 0/382 NaN, weekly-jump on 7/382 series (0-3 per cell), and MAD-8 isolated flags are occupancy right-tail (median occupancy ~0.05, MAD ~0.02, median isolated-MAD8 runs 16-43, vs injection.py count=40 labeled 8*nanstd points). All 6 cells look the same, so there is no difficulty gradient. Expected revision triggers from leftover defects ~0/lesson, below the proposed G1 bar (>=2/lesson). Wrong-family outlier repair of real occupancy peaks could produce negatives, but that is unmeasured and would be systematic (not a conflict field). Repeats S2a: a uniform pool cannot host C5b.
g1_readout.difficulty_tier_this_pool_can_host: easy only (identity / no-repair), analogous to traffic_clean_identity_00 plus a homogeneous occupancy-MAD tail; cannot host medium/hard natural gap or level-shift discovery; cannot host a conflict field

revision_trigger_expectation_per_lesson.qualitative: approximately zero from leftover defects; occupancy-peak misrepair sign unknown
revision_trigger_expectation_per_lesson.count_basis: nan_per_cell=[0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0] shift_per_cell=[3, 1, 2, 0, 1, 0] family_bearing_per_cell=[3, 1, 2, 0, 1, 0] raw_iso8_per_cell=[50, 58, 58, 56, 55, 58] occupancy_confounded=[True, True, True, True, True, True]

caveats: No consumer fit; G1 counts are defect-geometry proxies, not Episode labels.
Raw MAD-z on occupancy can flag diurnal peaks as 'outliers'; isolated-run<=3 is the family-aligned spike proxy.
Weekly-median jumps can fire on holiday/season occupancy changes; not the minipipe 40-96-pt excursion geometry (public_features._level_candidate).
Electricity leftover primary uses full leftover length; S2a sweep _load_pool only read 2500 rows.
Registry missing_rate=0 is the same-family paper label, not this leftover measurement.
Period_change family is in the taxonomy but was not requested and is not scored.

Raw MAD-z on occupancy flags diurnal/occupancy peaks: leftover median mean~0.05, MAD~0.02, isolated-MAD8 median 16-43 runs/series. That is occupancy-confounded, not injection.py impulsive_outlier. Headline richness therefore treats those flags as non-defects.
